data.body:
Rebase onto current origin/main (69cd2b9e15aa) — patchset 3 pushed, same Change-Id.

Conflict was the Makefile .PHONY line, resolved as a UNION with one deliberate exception:
  main  : ... check test e2e-deps jira-dc-up ...        (added e2e-deps, dropped scanner-integration)
  mine  : ... check verify test e2e-deps scanner-integration jira-dc-up ...
  merged: ... check verify test e2e-deps jira-dc-up ... (+ my PYTEST_WORKERS block)
I kept main's e2e-deps and my verify, and did NOT re-add scanner-integration: commit
9c7d78127696 removed that TARGET entirely (the 90c7 de-gating), so carrying the .PHONY entry
forward would have re-introduced a name with no rule. Verified by checking main's Makefile for
the target, not by assuming. My `make check` help-text correction still applies cleanly —
main's text there is unchanged from what I edited against.

Post-rebase gates:
  make lint       EXIT=0   complexity new=0 increased=0; mechanism new=0 increased=0
                           (the two previously-'admitted' scanner entries are gone with the
                           workflow main deleted, so the ratchet is now clean outright)
  make typecheck  EXIT=0   755 source files
  three named gates: 54 passed, 1 failed — and the failure is NOT from this change.

  tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py::test_a_marker_in_a_new_gate_scripts_head_admits_it
  ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'scripts._mechanism_delta'

Root-caused rather than retried: reproduced on a clean detached worktree of UNMODIFIED
origin/main, and bisected to 9c7d78127696 ('Revert scanner-integration Verified gate') — it
passes at 6b034b9f8224, my original base, and fails at every commit from 9c7d78 onward. It is
a narrow-selection-only failure; the full suite is green, which is why CI never saw it. Filed
as bug newborn-ethnologic-scaup (7f46-790d-7b9f-4db1), linked discovered_from this ticket. Not
fixed here: unrelated to this change, and folding it in would have bloated an approved change.

Full `make verify` is re-running on the rebased tree despite the conflict being docs/Makefile
text only, because main moved eight commits and I would rather measure than assume.
